title: Memory upkeep: one fact once, unused agent lines retired, disagreements left to a person
request: The owner: continue the memory plan to the end; 35.6 keeps memory short and true without deleting anything.
spec: MEMORY_PLAN.md 35.6: merge near-duplicates, retire the never-cited and the twice-harmful, list conflicts for a person; every change an event; nothing deleted.
plan: Build plan and apply over the store and the memory events.

decisions.decision: Merge only lines with the same words in the same order once filler words are set aside
decisions.why: a word overlap rule merged a negated line, swapped words and another column name into one, settling a disagreement by code

decisions.decision: A person's lines are never retired for not being cited
decisions.why: a preference such as 'answer simply' is followed without being named by id

decisions.decision: Writing words already remembered keeps the line as it was
decisions.why: an agent writing a person's words took over the line's authorship

change: dclab_rnd/memory/upkeep.py and __main__.py (new), memory/__init__.py (remember keeps an active line as it is), Makefile (memory-upkeep), tests.

findings.defect: Lines that disagree were merged, settling a conflict by code
findings.scenario: 'Use the time split…' and 'Never use the time split…' merged; so did swapped words, another column name, another unit and a Persian negation
findings.cause: a word-set overlap of 0.8 ignored order and treated one changed word as noise
findings.fix: merge only the same words in the same order, filler aside, never a negation; any other near pair is a conflict
findings.impact: the opposite of a rule kept, and its restatement refused as retired words

findings.defect: On PostgreSQL upkeep read and wrote the wrong event log
findings.scenario: shown counts were zero and retirements went to a file the Admin page never reads
findings.cause: the log was opened without the workspace's id
findings.fix: the database log when the workspace has one

findings.defect: Usage read only the newest 5,000 events
findings.scenario: a line cited once, then 5,000 other events, then shown 30 times: retired as never cited
findings.fix: only the memory events, all of them

findings.defect: A person's confirmed preference could retire as never cited
findings.scenario: after 30 sessions following 'answer in simple words' without naming it, the line retired and could never be proposed again
findings.fix: a person's lines are exempt from that rule

findings.defect: Numbers were compared as text, and corrections were left out of conflicts
findings.scenario: '30' and Persian '۳۰', '1,000' and '1000' listed as conflicts; an agent's 200 beside a person's corrected 150 never listed
findings.cause: raw strings; corrections excluded from the grouping
findings.fix: numbers normalised; corrections compared for conflicts only

findings.defect: An agent writing a person's words took over the person's line
findings.scenario: the same words in the same scope have one id; the agent's write became the latest version
findings.cause: remember wrote a new version of an active item
findings.fix: an active item with the same id is kept as it is

outcome: Memory upkeep is built and reviewed: only a fact said twice in the same words merges, disagreements go to a person, an agent's unused lines retire, a person's lines stay, and nothing is deleted.
lessons: A similarity score is not sameness: for facts, merge only what says the same thing word for word, and hand the rest to a person.
Read every event a rule depends on, never a default page of the newest.
risks: Nothing yet marks a line harmful.
